title: Wrapped trim text overlaps the price
symptom: The grey trim line under each car title has a fixed one-line height. When the trim wraps (longer localised trims in the narrow two-column cards just above the 768 px breakpoint), the second line spills down and is drawn on top of the large price, making both hard to read. From ~850 px the trims fit on one line and the problem disappears.
